recipe_version.title: Greek Chicken Souvlaki with Cucumber Salad
recipe_version.description: Lemon-oregano marinated chicken thigh skewers grilled or broiled, served with a dairy-free cucumber-tomato-dill salad.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp marinade, 1 tbsp for the cucumber salad

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.note: from about 2 lemons; divided marinade and salad

ingredients.name: English cucumber
ingredients.preparation: halved lengthwise, seeded if watery, and sliced 1/4 inch

ingredients.name: fresh dill
ingredients.note: chopped; salad finish — not yogurt tzatziki

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.body: In a bowl, whisk 3 tbsp olive oil, 3 tbsp of the lemon juice, the minced garlic, dried oregano, 1.25 tsp kosher salt, and black pepper. Add the chicken pieces and toss to coat. Marinate 20 minutes at room temperature (or up to 2 hours refrigerated). Meanwhile, soak 8 bamboo skewers in water if using wood.

steps.title: Make the cucumber salad
steps.body: In a serving bowl, combine the sliced cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced red onion, chopped dill, the remaining 1 tbsp lemon juice, the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, and the remaining 1/4 tsp kosher salt. Toss. No yogurt, no feta, no olives required. Hold while the chicken cooks.

steps.title: Thread the skewers
steps.body: Thread the marinated chicken onto 8 skewers, packing pieces snugly but not crushed. Discard leftover marinade that touched raw chicken; do not brush it on after cooking.

steps.title: Grill or broil the souvlaki
steps.body: Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high, or set an oven broiler to high with a rack 6 inches from the element (broiler path: preheat 5 minutes overlaps skewer threading). Cook the skewers, turning every 2 to 3 minutes, until chicken is browned in spots and the thickest piece reads 165 F, about 10 to 12 minutes total. Do not serve pink chicken.

steps.title: Plate
steps.body: Rest skewers 3 minutes. Serve 2 skewers per person with cucumber salad and lemon wedges. No pita, no tzatziki, no fries. kitchen_tested is false.

equipment: grill, grill pan, or oven broiler
recipe_version.heat: Grill or grill pan medium-high, or oven broiler on high 6 inches from element. Broiler preheat 5 minutes overlaps skewer threading.
recipe_version.doneness: Chicken 165 F in the thickest piece, browned in spots. Salad crisp, not watery. kitchen_tested is false.
